correctness.rationale: At s,t∈{±1}² coordinatewise Bernoulli rounding gives P_h(s,t)=((1+t1(as1+bs2))(1+t2(-bs1+as2)))/4 with a=1-h,b=hc. Summation over the four source spins cancels the cross term, yielding double stochasticity and π=1/4. The four clockwise neighbor probabilities equal p+=h(1+c)(2-h(1-c))/4 and reverse p-=h(1-c)(2-h(1+c))/4; p+-p-=hc. Opposite-corner transition pairs are symmetric. Entropy is (p+-p-) log(p+/p-), derivative of rate is +4c²/((2-h(1-c))(2-h(1+c)))>0. |a±ib|<1 gives convergent mean; all corners lie at squared distance 1/2. Direct 841 rational (h,c) pairs reproduce full P, stochasticity, neighbor flux, positivity. Valid for stated four initial corners and fresh coordinate rounding, not generic floating-point computation.
